#!/bin/bash

# Docker Cleanup Script
# Uses environment variables for configuration

# Default values
DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL=${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL:-"86400"} # 24 hours in seconds
DEFAULT_IMAGE_FILTERS=${DEFAULT_IMAGE_FILTERS:-"dangling=true"}
DEFAULT_CONTAINER_FILTERS=${DEFAULT_CONTAINER_FILTERS:-"status=exited"}
DEFAULT_VOLUME_FILTERS=${DEFAULT_VOLUME_FILTERS:-"dangling=true"}

# Configuration from environment variables (or defaults)
CLEANUP_INTERVAL=${CLEANUP_INTERVAL:-$DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL}
IMAGE_FILTERS=${IMAGE_FILTERS:-$DEFAULT_IMAGE_FILTERS}
CONTAINER_FILTERS=${CONTAINER_FILTERS:-$DEFAULT_CONTAINER_FILTERS}
VOLUME_FILTERS=${VOLUME_FILTERS:-$DEFAULT_VOLUME_FILTERS}

echo "Docker Cleanup Configuration:"
echo "Cleanup Interval: $CLEANUP_INTERVAL seconds"
echo "Image Filters: $IMAGE_FILTERS"
echo "Container Filters: $CONTAINER_FILTERS"
echo "Volume Filters: $VOLUME_FILTERS"
echo ""

# Function to clean up docker images
cleanup_images() {
    echo "Cleaning up docker images..."
    if [ "$IMAGE_FILTERS" != "none" ]; then
        docker image prune -f --filter "$IMAGE_FILTERS"
    else
        echo "Skipping image cleanup (filters set to 'none')"
    fi
}

# Function to clean up docker containers
cleanup_containers() {
    echo "Cleaning up docker containers..."
    if [ "$CONTAINER_FILTERS" != "none" ]; then
        docker container prune -f --filter "$CONTAINER_FILTERS"
    else
        echo "Skipping container cleanup (filters set to 'none')"
    fi
}

# Function to clean up docker volumes
cleanup_volumes() {
    echo "Cleaning up docker volumes..."
    if [ "$VOLUME_FILTERS" != "none" ]; then
        docker volume prune -f --filter "$VOLUME_FILTERS"
    else
        echo "Skipping volume cleanup (filters set to 'none')"
    fi
}

# Function to clean up docker networks
cleanup_networks() {
    echo "Cleaning up docker networks..."
    docker network prune -f
}

# Function to clean up build cache
cleanup_build_cache() {
    echo "Cleaning up build cache..."
    docker builder prune -f
}

# Main cleanup function
perform_cleanup() {
    echo "$(date): Starting Docker cleanup..."
    
    cleanup_images
    cleanup_containers
    cleanup_volumes
    cleanup_networks
    cleanup_build_cache
    
    echo "$(date): Docker cleanup completed."
    echo "----------------------------------------"
}

# Run cleanup immediately
perform_cleanup

# If running in daemon mode, loop with interval
if [ "$DAEMON_MODE" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Running in daemon mode with interval: $CLEANUP_INTERVAL seconds"
    while true; do
        sleep $CLEANUP_INTERVAL
        perform_cleanup
    done
else
    echo "Daemon mode not enabled. Exiting after single cleanup."
fi
